theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+2.85%) and Technology (+2.39%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.37%) and Consumer Staples (-0.24%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +2.36% versus -0.06% for defensives and +0.41% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +1.48%, Dow +1.32%, Nasdaq +2.13% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +1.73%. The VIX fell 0.81% to 15.86, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.12% to $4,121.30, crude oil was little changed at $80.91, and bitcoin gained 0.45% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
